// Load json file into character sheet.

// Rows are created dynamically and their element ids are not contiguous,
// so address inputs by class + index, the same way savetoFile() reads them.
function loadRows (cls) {
    return d3.selectAll(cls).nodes()
}

function loadEnsureRow (cls, i, button) {
    let guard = 0
    while (loadRows(cls).length <= i && guard++ < 200) {
        const addRow = d3.select(button).on('click')
        if (!addRow) break
        addRow()
    }
}

function loadSet (cls, i, value) {
    const node = loadRows(cls)[i]
    if (node) node.value = (value === undefined || value === null) ? '' : value
}

function loadCheck (cls, i, value) {
    const node = loadRows(cls)[i]
    if (node) node.checked = value === true
}

function loadValue (selector, value) {
    const node = d3.select(selector).node()
    if (node) node.value = (value === undefined || value === null) ? '' : value
}

function loadText (selector, value) {
    const node = d3.select(selector).node()
    if (node) node.textContent = (value === undefined || value === null) ? '' : value
}

loadFile = {
    ////////////////////////////
if (char != undefined){


    // Name and basic info
    loadValue('#Name', char.Name);
    loadText('#charClass dd', char.Class);
    loadText('#charRace dd', char.Race);
    loadText('#charLevel dd', char.Level);
    loadText('#charExperience dd', char.Experience);

    loadValue('#hp1', char.HP);
    loadValue('#hp2', char.MaxHP);
    loadValue('#ACinput', char.AC);
    loadValue('#HDinput', char.HD);

    loadText('#BABbox', char.BAB);
    loadText('#MovementBox', char.Movement);
    loadText('#InitiativeBox', char.Initiative);

    // Abilities
    const abilities = char.Abilities || {}

    loadValue('#strNum', abilities.Str);
    loadValue('#dexNum', abilities.Dex);
    loadValue('#conNum', abilities.Con);
    loadValue('#wisNum', abilities.Wis);
    loadValue('#intNum', abilities.Int);
    loadValue('#chaNum', abilities.Cha);

    // Saved scores come back as strings, so coerce before looking up the
    // modifier, and match the "( x )" format used while typing.
    const showMod = (sel, score) =>
        loadText(sel, `( ${calculateModifier(Number(score))} )`)

    showMod("#strMod", abilities.Str)
    showMod("#dexMod", abilities.Dex)
    showMod("#conMod", abilities.Con)
    showMod("#intMod", abilities.Int)
    showMod("#wisMod", abilities.Wis)
    showMod("#chaMod", abilities.Cha)


    // Saves
    const saves = char.Saves || {}

    loadValue('#save-drpBox', saves.DRP);
    loadValue('#save-wandBox', saves.MW);
    loadValue('#save-parBox', saves.Par);
    loadValue('#save-dbBox', saves.DB);
    loadValue('#save-spellBox', saves.Spl);


    // Thieving skills
    const thief = char.ThiefSkills || {}

    loadValue('#thiefLocksInput', thief.OpenLocks);
    loadValue('#thiefTrapInput', thief.RemoveTraps);
    loadValue('#thiefPocketsInput', thief.PickPockets);
    loadValue('#thiefSilentInput', thief.MoveSilent);
    loadValue('#thiefClimbInput', thief.ClimbWalls);
    loadValue('#thiefHideInput', thief.Hide);
    loadValue('#thiefListenInput', thief.Listen);

    // Langs and other skills

    const langs = char.Languages || []
    const oSkills = char.OtherSkills || []

    langs.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.lang', i, '#addInputButton')
        loadSet('.lang', i, x)
    });

    oSkills.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.oskill', i, '#addSkillButton')
        loadSet('.oskill', i, x)
    });

    /// Attacks
    const weaponEq = char.WeaponEq || []

    weaponEq.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.weaponForm', i, '#addWeaponButton')
        loadSet('.weaponForm', i, x.name);
        loadSet('.attackForm', i, x.attack);
        loadSet('.damageForm', i, x.damage);
        loadSet('.rangeSForm', i, x.S);
        loadSet('.rangeMForm', i, x.M);
        loadSet('.rangeLForm', i, x.L);
        loadSet('.notesForm', i, x.notes);
    });


    // Ammo
    const ammoEq = char.AmmoEq || []

    ammoEq.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.ammoForm', i, '#addAmmoButton')
        loadSet('.ammoForm', i, x.name);
        loadSet('.countForm', i, x.count);
        loadSet('.ammoDmgForm', i, x.damage);
        loadSet('.ammo-notesForm', i, x.notes);
    });

    /// Turn Undead

    const turning = char.Turning || []

    turning.forEach( (x,i) => loadSet('.turningForm', i, x) );

    // spells
    const spells = char.Spells || []

    spells.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.spell-name', i, '#addSpellButton')
        loadSet('.spell-level', i, x.spellLvl);
        loadSet('.spell-name', i, x.spellName);
        loadSet('.spell-prep', i, x.prep);
    });

    // Currency
    const equipment = char.Equipment || {}
    const currency = equipment.Currency || {}

    loadText('#PPbox', currency.pp)
    loadText('#GPbox', currency.gp)
    loadText('#EPbox', currency.ep)
    loadText('#SPbox', currency.sp)
    loadText('#CPbox', currency.cp)


    // Weapon Inventory
    const weaponsInv = equipment.Weapons || []

    weaponsInv.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.weaponsEqName', i, '#addWeaponEqButton')
        loadCheck('.weaponsEqMag', i, x.magic);
        loadCheck('.weaponsEqEq', i, x.equipped);
        loadSet('.weaponsEqName', i, x.name);
        loadSet('.weaponsEqWeight', i, x.weight);
    });

    // armor Inventory
    const armorInv = equipment.Armor || []

    armorInv.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.armorName', i, '#addArmorEqButton')
        loadCheck('.armorMagical', i, x.magic);
        loadCheck('.armorEquipped', i, x.equipped);
        loadSet('.armorName', i, x.name);
        loadSet('.armorWeight', i, x.weight);
    });

    // Misc Inventory
    const miscInv = equipment.Misc || []

    miscInv.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.miscName', i, '#addItemEqButton')
        loadCheck('.miscMagical', i, x.magic);
        loadCheck('.miscEquipped', i, x.equipped);
        loadSet('.miscName', i, x.name);
        loadSet('.miscWeight', i, x.weight);
    });

    // Sum the carried weight once everything is in place.
    calcWeight();

    /// notes
    const hirelings = char.Hirelings || []

    hirelings.forEach( (x,i) => {
        loadEnsureRow('.hirelings', i, '#addHirelingButton')
        loadSet('.hirelings', i, x);
    });

    loadValue('#background', char.Background);
    loadValue('#miscNotes', char.MiscNotes);

}// if
///////////////////////////////////
}
